Before you order

Know what to expect.

Production and delivery time can vary by design, size and destination. Confirm the current timeline, delivery access requirements and custom specifications with ShivaArt before placing your order.

Ask on WhatsApp Shipping policy

Helpful answers

Frequently asked questions.

Can I customise a design? +

Yes. Share your preferred dimensions, colour, pattern, material and finish on WhatsApp. ShivaArt will confirm feasibility and the final order details before production.

How long will my order take? +

Timelines vary by product, complexity and destination. Check the estimate shown on the current product page and confirm it with ShivaArt before ordering, especially for large or custom furniture.

Do you ship internationally? +

Yes. ShivaArt advertises worldwide shipping support. Confirm any destination-specific, remote-area or special-access requirements before placing the order.

Can designers and hospitality buyers enquire? +

Yes. Interior designers, architects, hotels, villas, boutiques, retailers and wholesale buyers can discuss quantities, specifications and project requirements on WhatsApp.

How should bone inlay furniture be maintained? +

Wipe gently with a soft, dry cloth. Avoid excessive moisture, harsh chemical cleaners and prolonged direct sunlight. Follow any product-specific care instructions supplied with your order.

What if the wrong item arrives or it is damaged in transit? +

Contact ShivaArt promptly and keep the original packaging. Share clear photos or video of the product and packaging so the team can review the issue under the current return and refund policy.
